title: Emerging Market Trader
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Emerging Market Trader em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role OverviewWe are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African/LATAM/Asian currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies, with a focus on African (e.G., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.) on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions. Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure. Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.  Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization. Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure, including: Automated hedging engines Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring.  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies, such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades.  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets NDF markets and offshore hedging Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems Hedging engines Liquidity aggregation platforms Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution.  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments. Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations. Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources. Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies. Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's "killer app," with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: English Teacher With Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Nova vaga disponível para English Teacher With Advanced Portuguese Skills em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you're looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we've got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.  Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.  Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

description:
Confira a oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer (Pleno) | Node.Js + React + Php em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem somos?Somos uma healthtech de Ribeirão Preto (SP) que combate fraudes, desperdícios e inconsistências na saúde por meio da Carefy, uma plataforma de auditoria com inteligência artificial. Nossa missão é construir a infraestrutura de auditoria inteligente para um sistema de saúde mais eficiente, econômico e acessível — algo que já colocamos em prática ao apoiar dezenas de planos de saúde no país, como Hapvida, Porto Seguro Saúde e diversas Unimeds. Conheça os valores e como a gente trabalha na Carefy: Fazer acontecer: A gente executa, mesmo sem cenário perfeito. Jogar limpo: Somos transparentes, ética e claros em todas as relações. Desafio move a gente: Aqui, problema difícil não trava, motiva. Buscamos gente curiosa, fuçada e autodirigida, que vai atrás da resposta e faz acontecer. Aprender rápido: Errar faz parte do processo, repetir erro, não. A gente testa, ajusta e evolui com velocidade. Cliente no centro: Se não gera valor real para o cliente, a gente repensa. 2 é maior que 1: Acreditamos em colaboração de verdade, e você não estará sozinho. Feito é melhor que perfeito: A gente entrega, aprende com o uso e melhora rápido. Aqui não é lugar de burocracia ou preciosismo pela perfeição.  Qual o desafio? Buscamos uma pessoa para atuar em um momento estratégico da nossa evolução tecnológica. Você terá o desafio duplo de manter e evoluir nossa base atual e, paralelamente, ser uma peça-chave na modernização da nossa arquitetura. Isso envolve a migração ativa de serviços legados para stacks modernas e a implementação de novos padrões de escalabilidade e isolamento de dados. O que você irá fazer no dia-a-dia? A missão dessa vaga é desenvolver e melhorar constantemente a nossa plataforma, garantindo a transição fluida entre tecnologias e mantendo a alta disponibilidade para nossos clientes. Desenvolvimento e Sustentação: Atuar na manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes em PHP (CodeIgniter), garantindo estabilidade e performance. Modernização e Migração: Desenvolver novos serviços, APIs e microsserviços utilizando Node.Js (JavaScript/TypeScript), apoiando ativamente a migração do nosso legado. Arquitetura e Banco de Dados: Participar da modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL). Frontend: Criar e dar manutenção em interfaces responsivas e dinâmicas utilizando HTML, CSS, JavaScript (Vanilla e frameworks modernos). Qualidade e Segurança: Escrever código limpo, realizar code reviews, implementar testes (unitários e de integração) e aplicar boas práticas de segurança. Cloud e DevOps: Apoiar nas esteiras de CI/CD e interagir com infraestrutura em nuvem (GCP) com foco em eficiência e redução de custos.  O que esperamos de você? Pra gente, o que realmente importa é ter match com a nossa cultura, mas, para essa vaga, temos algumas características que consideramos essenciais: Trabalho em equipe: Colaborar de forma transparente com outros desenvolvedores, arquitetos e liderança técnica. Flexibilidade e Adaptação: Transitar confortavelmente entre o legado (PHP) e a nova stack (Node.Js), entendendo o valor de ambos para o negócio. Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura. Gestão de tempo e Autonomia: Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa.  Quais são os requisitos? Experiência de 3+ anos em desenvolvimento de software;  Experiência de 2+ anos com Node.Js e TypeScript em produção Experiência de 1+ anos com PHP em produção;  Experiência de 2+ anos com Tecnologias Web em produção;  Experiência de 2+ anos com Bancos de Dados Relacionais (MySQL), incluindo modelagem;  Experiência comfilas e mensageria (RabbitMQ);  Conhecimento deframeworks modernos como NestJS e/ou Next.Js;  Conhecimento empadrões de arquitetura (Clean Architecture, SOLID);  Conhecimento sólido em Git e versionamento de código;  Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban);  Habilidade paratrabalhar de forma colaborativa.  Será um diferencial: Experiência em migração de sistemas monolíticos/legados para microsserviços;  Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Familiaridade com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2);  Conhecimento prático na integração de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) e no desenvolvimento de fluxos utilizando AI Agents.  O que oferecemos? Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido (para residentes em Ribeirão Preto e região) ou 100% Remoto (para candidatos de outras localidades);  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  6 dias de folgaanuais + folga de aniversário;  Bônus de indicação;  Bônus de equipe; Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VA e VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!  Faça parte da nossa revolução na saúde! Dúvidas? Fale com a gente:

description:

Sobre o Grupo Escalada   Somos um ecossistema com diversas soluções para empresas que desejam vender os seus produtos na internet ou que já vendem e querem aumentar os seus resultados. Nosso propósito é transformar o comércio digital no Brasil. Aqui, valorizamos inovação, autonomia, aprendizado contínuo e pessoas com brilho nos olhos.    Representada por  Dhiego Rosa – Instagram: @dhiegorosa e YouTube: dhiegorosa   – contamos com mais de 700 mil seguidores nas redes sociais. Somos referência no universo das vendas online, fruto de uma experiência de mais de 13 anos no segmento, criando, vendendo empresas e consolidando marcas no mercado.    Nosso treinamento é reconhecido pela Amazon e pelo Mercado Livre, destacando-nos como uma das maiores empresas de mentorias e treinamentos para e-commerce da América Latina.   O que buscamos:    Buscamos um(a)  Gerente de Operações da Mentoria   para liderar e estruturar a operação da nossa principal linha de negócio, garantindo eficiência operacional, padronização de processos, qualidade na entrega e desenvolvimento da equipe.   Procuramos um profissional com perfil estratégico e analítico, alta capacidade de gestão, autonomia para tomada de decisão e experiência em operações escaláveis, capaz de atuar diretamente na evolução da experiência dos mentorados e crescimento sustentável da área.    Responsabilidades:    Liderar equipe de mentores, supervisores e suporte, acompanhando performance, desenvolvimento e estruturação do time;    Garantir qualidade e consistência da operação de mentoria, assegurando padronização de processos, entregas e experiência do cliente;    Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar fluxos operacionais, metodologias e processos internos;    Acompanhar e analisar indicadores operacionais, como NPS, churn, engajamento, capacidade operacional e satisfação dos mentorados;    Realizar gestão de crises, tratativas de casos críticos, conflitos e demandas sensíveis de clientes;    Planejar capacidade operacional da equipe, onboarding e desenvolvimento de novos mentores;    Atuar de forma integrada com áreas como Comercial, RH, Financeiro, Marketing e Produto.    Requisitos:    Ensino superior completo em Administração, Engenharia, Processos Gerenciais, Gestão de Projetos ou áreas correlatas;    Experiência mínima de 5 anos em gestão de operações, customer success, consultoria, educação executiva ou áreas correlatas;    Experiência comprovada em estruturação de processos, padronização de entrega e gestão por indicadores em empresas de serviço continuado, como educação executiva, consultoria, mentoria, treinamento corporativo, SaaS B2B ou customer success de alto contato;    Experiência prévia com liderança de equipes operacionais de médio/grande porte;    Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e acompanhamento de performance, incluindo OKRs, KPIs, dashboards gerenciais, CRM e plataformas de operação digital;    Capacidade analítica para leitura de indicadores, tomada de decisão baseada em dados e implementação de melhorias contínuas;    Capacidade demonstrável de atuar com autonomia, senso de dono e reporte de resultados, sem dependência de direcionamento constante;    Perfil analítico, organizado, resiliente e com forte capacidade de liderança;    Vivência em operações escaláveis e ambientes de crescimento acelerado.     Diferenciais:    Experiência com infoprodutos, mentorias, educação online ou consultorias;    Conhecimento em e-commerce, marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee) e comércio digital;    Vivência em empresas de alto crescimento, scale-ups ou operações com ticket elevado;    Vivência empreendedora ou passagem por empresas em fase de crescimento acelerado, com familiaridade em ambientes dinâmicos, alta autonomia e processos em estruturação;    Compreensão da realidade do pequeno e médio empreendedor brasileiro, incluindo desafios relacionados à tributação, capital de giro, sazonalidade e gestão operacional.     Se você se identifica com a nossa missão de impactar o mercado de e-commerce e busca crescer em um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador, queremos conhecer você!   Venha construir o futuro do comércio digital conosco no Grupo Escalada

title: Technical Assistant
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Technical Assistant em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Do you have experience in the technical field – preparing technical reports, testing equipment and providing a high level of customer service? Are you self-driven and goal-oriented, with a technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability?  At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Technical Assistant based in Campinas.    DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions.     About The Job    The Technical Assistant will serve as a key member of the team, performing equipment testing and repairs, carrying out projects and applications of controls and instruments under technical parameters, and working under collaboration with our global colleagues.    Working Tasks and Responsibilities    Carrying out equipment testing and repair activities in accordance with DEIF’s technical processes, ensuring formal process requirements are met and keeping internal record systems up to date.   Managing projects and applications of controls and instruments, developing technical specifications for equipment according to customer requirements.   Providing technical support and service to internal and external customers, by telephone or in person.   Carrying out commissioning, installation, start-up and field technical assistance.   Preparing training materials and conducting training sessions for customers, either at DEIF facilities or at our customers’ sites.   Specifying necessary components for repair, application or technical support of equipment for customer quotation.   Providing technical support to the sales department as needed.   Preparing technical documentation for the execution and sale of product applications and related projects.     What You’ll Bring    Technical training in electrical/ electronic fields. Higher education (University Degree) is an advantage.   Experience in the technical field, preferably in power generation – electrical/electronic.   Experience in preparing technical reports and handling client interactions.   Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking.   Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills.   Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player.   Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace.     Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.    At DEIF, we are Winning Together!   We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.    We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category.    Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at.

title: Senior Mobile Developer (React Native)
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior Mobile Developer (React Native) em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

AboutFlatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development. Job Summary This role is heavily focused on cross-platform mobile development using React Native, while also requiring solid understanding of native mobile development concepts for both iOS and Android environments. The ideal candidate has strong experience working with mobile advertising ecosystems, video player integrations, and content-heavy applications at scale. Candidates with previous experience in media, publishing, streaming, or broadcast environments are highly preferred. Responsibilities Develop and maintain scalable cross-platform mobile applications using React Native for iOS and Android. Collaborate with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and QA teams in an Agile environment. Integrate and maintain mobile advertising solutions such as Google Ad Manager (GAM), DoubleClick, or similar ad stack technologies. Work with video playback technologies and SDKs including native players, Video.Js, JW Player, or similar solutions. Implement performant, responsive, and reliable mobile user experiences for content-heavy applications. Debug and resolve issues across both React Native and native mobile layers when necessary. Contribute to architecture decisions and mobile engineering best practices. Optimize application performance, stability, and maintainability. Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions. Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo's product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes:  -  Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection  -  Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats  -  Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production  -  Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases  -  Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value  -  Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling  -  Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time  -  Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS  -  Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them. Requirements You bring:  -  At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience  -  Strong Python skills  -  Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3  -  Real production experience with ML on AWS  -  Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning  -  Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data  -  Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content  -  A strong eye for correctness and data quality  -  Business level English  -  The ability to work independently in a small remote team  -  A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership Conditions  -  12 month B2B contract  -  Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap  -  Flat structure with direct communication  -  Production product with real users and real data problems  -  Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence  -  Compensation based on senior contractor level The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo's needs.

Familiarity with SaaS, professional services, and vendor agreements. Excellent English skills, both written and spoken.Mindset & Strengths Commercial pragmatism. You understand that legal review serves business outcomes, and you know when to push, when to compromise, and when to escalate. Clear written communication. You can explain complex legal positions to non-lawyers in plain language and translate client redlines into clear recommendations. Calm and thorough under deadline pressure. You can manage multiple active negotiations without losing track of detail. Independent operator. You can run a contract review process end-to-end with limited supervision and know when to surface issues to leadership. Discretion and trustworthiness. You handle confidential business information with care. A no-ego collaborator. You build trust through transparent communication, take ownership of your work, and welcome feedback.Why Join Us Fully remote, flexible schedule with ET overlap. Work directly with founders and executive leadership on agreements that shape the company's growth. Opportunity to build out the legal function and contracting infrastructure at a fast-moving company. Exposure to a diverse, enterprise client base across industries and geographies.IMPORTANT Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.Compensation:$40-60/hour depending on experience

title: Ai Implementation Lead (Technical Pm For Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems)
description:
Empresa está contratando Ai Implementation Lead (Technical Pm For Agents & Agentic / Automated Systems) em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Zaigo builds custom AI systems for founder-led, middle-market companies — the kind of businesses with messy operations, real revenue, and legacy software in place. They are thinking about how to leverage AI but don't know where to start. We turn manual workflows and inefficiencies into production AI systems, fast. We are hiring anAI Implementation Leadto own client delivery end-to-end inside a pod structure. You will run 5–10 client accounts at once, with 2–3 senior AI engineers reporting into your pod, and you will be the person the client trusts to get things shipped.Think of this as aprincipal-level role at a consulting firm: a senior partner sets the strategy and owns the relationship at the top, you own the execution and the day-to-day client trust, and your engineers do the heavy build. You are the person who keeps everything moving, makes the calls, and ships.What you'll actually doOwn the client. You'll run discovery calls, scope the work, set expectations, give status updates, manage scope creep, and be the steady hand the client calls when something is on fire. Many of our clients are non-technical executives running real businesses — you need to be able to translate\ "we have this messy thing happening in our operations\ " into a concrete AI system, in plain English, without jargon.Architect the solution.On a discovery call, you should be able to sketch out a working solution in real time:\ "Okay, this is a RAG problem with a chat layer on top, we'll use these 5 specialized agents to handle X, Y, and Z, output formatted to your Excel template, and we'll integrate with your existing CRM via API calls.\ " You don't need to write theproduction code, but you need to know enough to confidently scope it, pick the right framework, point to the right open-source repo, and know roughly what's hard vs. easy.Run the pod.Translate the scoped solution into engineering tasks, hand it off cleanly, unblock the engineers, and review the work. You can't read every line of AI-generated code — nobody can anymore. You're evaluating whether the output is directionally right, whether the UX makes sense, whether the architecture will hold up, and whether it actually solves the client's problem. Strong product intuition matters more than line-by-line review.Prototype when needed.You're a player-coach. You should be comfortable opening Cursor or Claude Code to validate an approach, build a quick demo for a client call, or prototype a tricky workflow before handing it to engineers. You're not shipping production code as your main job, but you can build.Juggle.You'll have ~10 active projects across 5–10 clients at any time. Deadlines slip, priorities shift, clients change their minds. You stay calm, communicate proactively, and keep everything moving.Who you areYou have at least 5–8 years of experience in some combination of technical product management, solutions engineering, technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or running your own thing. You may have been a founder. You may have been a PM at a fast company who got tired of waiting for engineers and started vibe coding your own stuff.You're technically literate in a hands-on way: you can vibe code, you know the major agentic frameworks (Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK etc.), you understand RAG architectures, you know when to use a vector DB vs. a graph DB vs. just dumping things into context, you've shipped things using AI tools.You communicate exceptionally well in English, both written and verbal. You're comfortable on a Zoom call with a 62-year-old CEO who has never heard of Loom and explaining to him, patiently, what we're building and why it matters for his business. You have founder-grade ownership. You don't say\ "that wasn't in the ticket.\"You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do next. You see the gap, you close it.This role is for you ifYou can take a messy business problem and produce a clear, shippable architecture for it within a single call.You like running a lot of things at once and you don't drop balls.You're excited about AI-assisted building and you use these tools every day already.You want to work alongside experienced founders and senior engineers, with real ownership and real client exposure, in a fast-growing company.This role is not for you ifYou want to write production code all day.You're a pure project manager who needs a PRD and a Jira board to function.You're uncomfortable on the phone with non-technical executives.You need a manager to tell you what to prioritize this week.You avoid ambiguity.LocationFully remote. We're focused on candidates based in Brazil with strong daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.How to applyTo apply, pleaseemail(not DM) the following directly toand copy:Your resume A short Loom video (5–10 minutes max, must be a Loom link) walking us through one technical or operational project you personally ownedIn the Loom, cover: The business problem you were solving Your specific role The technical workflow or architecture at a high level The biggest challenge you solved How you organized and managed deliveryWe strongly prefer candidates who can explain complex technical systems clearly, concisely, and in plain English.Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.

description:

Who are we?Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;  JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Data Analyst em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About us:Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world's leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we've made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. LearnIntroduction: We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you'll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You'll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.Responsibilities: Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries. Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities. Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies. Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor. Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways. Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders. Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling. Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality. Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency. Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna's analytics capabilities.Your profile: 5+ years of professional experience in data analytics, advanced analytics, or market research roles. Bachelor's or master's degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, or a related field. Advanced proficiency in Python, R, SQL, SPSS and/or Sawtooth Strong command of statistical modeling, segmentation, predictive analytics, and experimental design. Proven ability to lead analytical projects from scoping to delivery, including stakeholder management and quality assurance. Excellent communication and storytelling skills, able to translate complex data findings into business implications. Hands-on experience applying AI or machine learning in real-world analytics contexts, beyond academic or purely experimental work. Familiarity with large language models and their practical use in analytics workflows, such as building or supervising AI agents, prompt-driven analysis, or automated insight generation. Strong judgment around model quality, bias, explainability, and appropriate use of AI in client-facing analytical work. Ability to clearly explain AI-driven approaches and limitations to non-technical stakeholders in plain business language. Experience mentoring or leading junior analysts or cross-functional workstreams. Must be fluent in English, with additional languages being a plus.**Please submit your CV in English.Our Values: Acting with Ownership- Demonstrating individual accountability Bringing a forward mindset- Being action-oriented, bold and entrepreneurial Collaborating with Curiosity- Exhibiting teamwork through togetherness Discussing openly, committing jointly- Sharing your views openly Embracing empathy- Being egoless & caringWhat we offer: At Toluna, we're all about creating a welcoming, diverse workplace where everyone can thrive. We offer competitive pay, great benefits, and plenty of opportunities to grow within our global team. Inclusion and respect are at the heart of what we do. Our community connects over 72 million people across 70 countries. If you're passionate about making an impact, we'd love to have you on board.Other Benefits:Healthcare, dental care, life insurance, a meal voucher, a transportation voucher, and a language class subsidy.Join our global team. We welcome big thinking and reward great work.

Implementação e Operação: ➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução. ➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente. ➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas. Requisitos e qualificações Experiência: ➢ Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos. ➢ Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas. ➢ Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.). ➢ Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil. Conhecimentos Técnicos: ➢ Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.). ➢ Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a micros serviços. ➢ Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.Js, Cloud, etc.). ➢ Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML). ➢ Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia). ➢ Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas. ➢ Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git). ➢ Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças. Habilidades: ➢ Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio. ➢ Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas. ➢ Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas. ➢ Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos. ➢ Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada. ➢ Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento. title: Senior Treasury Analyst
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior Treasury Analyst em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

The Senior Treasury Analyst will be responsible for managing bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across the LATAM region, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations while optimizing the company's credit capacity and minimizing collateral requirements.The role will also support regional cash management activities, liquidity planning, and foreign exchange operations while maintaining strong relationships with banks, insurance providers, and internal stakeholders.Key Responsibilities 1. Guarantees & Surety Management (Primary Focus)-  Manage the full lifecycle of guarantees, including issuance, amendments, renewals, reductions, and cancellations of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds across LATAM countries.-  Review guarantees wording and contractual obligations, ensuring alignment with company policies and minimizing financial and legal risk exposure.-  Provide recommendations for alternative guarantee structures (insurance vs bank guarantee vs standby instruments) to optimize cost, credit utilization, and collateral requirements.-  Coordinate with banks, insurance companies, and brokers to establish and maintain guarantee facilities and credit lines.-  Support the negotiation of guarantee terms to reduce costs, improve conditions, and avoid or minimize cash collateral requirements.-  Monitor guarantee utilization levels and facility limits, ensuring sufficient availability to support ongoing business operations and new contracts.-  Maintain a guarantee tracking system/database to monitor expiration dates, renewals, and contractual obligations.-  Work closely with legal, procurement, and commercial teams to review contract clauses related to financial guarantees, performance bonds, advance payment bonds, and retention guarantees.-  Ensure timely release or reduction of guarantees when contractual obligations are fulfilled.-  Support risk assessments related to guarantees, including country risk, counterparty risk, and insurer/bank exposure.-  Assist in building and maintaining strategic relationships with financial institutions and insurers across the LATAM region.Cash Management & Treasury Operations-  Monitor daily cash balances across LATAM bank accounts, ensuring adequate liquidity and compliance with corporate treasury policies.-  Support regional liquidity planning and cash positioning, including funding requirements between accounts.-  Execute manual payments through banking platforms, including payments related to taxes, payroll, and judicial obligations.-  Maintain accurate cash forecasting and treasury reporting in the IT2 Treasury Management System.-  Support the execution and documentation of foreign exchange (FX) transactions required for LATAM operations.-  Monitor FX exposure and support compliance with internal treasury policies and local regulatory requirements.-  Assist in maintaining bank account documentation, including the management and reporting of authorized bank account signatories.-  Ensure proper documentation and reconciliation of treasury transactions, addressing any discrepancies or queries.-  Support internal and external audits related to treasury activities. Stakeholder Management-  Collaborate closely with Legal, Finance, Tax, and Commercial teams to ensure proper structuring of guarantees and financial obligations within contracts.-  Support on maintain effective relationships with banks, insurers, and brokers to support regional treasury operations.-  Act as a key contact for guarantee-related matters within the organization. Requirements Education-  Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. Professional Experience-  Minimum 5 years of experience in a corporate treasury environment, with exposure to bank guarantees, surety bonds, or insurance guarantees.-  Experience working with LATAM treasury operations is highly desirable.Technical Knowledge-  Solid knowledge of bank guarantees, insurance guarantees, and surety bonds.-  Understanding of foreign exchange (FX) operations and compliance requirements.-  Experience using Treasury Management Systems (preferably IT2).-  Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Skills & Competencies-  Strong analytical and financial problem-solving skills.-  Ability to review contractual financial terms and assess risk exposure.-  Strong negotiation skills when dealing with banks, insurers, and brokers.-  Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.-  Ability to work under time-sensitive conditions and manage multiple priorities.-  Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Languages-  Advanced English (required).-  Intermediate Spanish (desirable).Candidatos da cidade de São Paulo - SP, residir 24 KM do escritório da Unisys localizado na (zona sul - ponte João Dias), terá ir presencial 3 vezes na semana presencial.

Você se reportará diretamente ao Gerente de Engenharia e colaborará estreitamente com Produto, QA e outras equipes de engenharia para entregar uma experiência de CRM confiável, performática e amigável ao usuário.O Que Você Fará- Deter a visão técnica e arquitetura para a camada de funcionalidades do CRM, abrangendo tanto os fluxos de engajamento do cliente quanto as ferramentas focadas em receita. - Liderar e mentorar aproximadamente 12 engenheiros em duas equipes de funcionalidades, incluindo a condução de revisões de código (code reviews), facilitação de discussões técnicas e orientação de crescimento de carreira. - Coordenar o trabalho entre ambas as equipes de CRM para garantir consistência na arquitetura, padrões de codificação e qualidade de lançamento (release). - Impulsionar a evolução do stack da aplicação frontend, incluindo a migração de frameworks legados para arquiteturas modernas baseadas em Angular. - Parceria com Produto para decompor funcionalidades complexas em incrementos entregáveis e bem definidos, que equilibrem a experiência do usuário com a viabilidade técnica. - Estabelecer e aplicar padrões de engenharia para qualidade de código, cobertura de testes, documentação e práticas de codificação segura. - Responsabilizar-se pela camada de autenticação e gerenciamento de sessão, garantindo experiências de usuário seguras e confiáveis (JWT, renovação de token, manipulação de sessão). - Gerenciar a dívida técnica de forma estratégica, priorizando esforços de refatoração que reduzam as taxas de bugs e melhorem a velocidade do desenvolvedor (velocity). - Colaborar com as equipes de Plataforma, IA e SRE em serviços compartilhados, modelos de dados e preocupações transversais (cross-cutting concerns). - Participar do planejamento de sprints, estimativa e gestão de capacidade para ambas as equipes. - Contribuir para os esforços de contratação, incluindo a definição de requisitos da função, triagem de candidatos e condução de entrevistas técnicas.O Que Você Traz (Requisitos)- Mais de 7 anos de experiência profissional em engenharia de software, com pelo menos 2 anos em cargo de liderança técnica (Tech Lead, Staff Engineer ou equivalente). - Forte proficiência full-stack com PHP (CakePHP ou frameworks MVC semelhantes) no backend e Angular ou um framework frontend moderno comparável (React, Vue) no frontend.- Experiência profunda com MySQL em escala de produção, incluindo design de schema, otimização de consultas e solução de problemas de desempenho. - Sólida compreensão de Node.Js e TypeScript para componentes do lado do servidor ou middleware. - Experiência liderando equipes de 8 ou mais engenheiros, com histórico comprovado de mentoria, feedback de desempenho e construção de cultura de equipe. - Forte compreensão de padrões de autenticação e autorização (JWT, OAuth, gerenciamento de sessão, rotação de token). - Excelentes habilidades de comunicação com a capacidade de traduzir compensações (trade-offs) técnicas para Produto, QA e stakeholders de negócio. - Familiaridade com metodologias Agile/Scrum e ferramentas (Jira, Confluence ou similares). - Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD, controle de versão (Git/Bitbucket) e fluxos de trabalho de desenvolvimento modernos. - Capacidade demonstrada de coordenar o trabalho entre várias equipes ou squads em direção a objetivos compartilhados. - Experiência demonstrada no uso de ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistidas por IA nos fluxos diários de engenharia. Isso inclui ferramentas como Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Amazon CodeWhisperer ou assistentes de codificação de IA semelhantes para tarefas como geração de código, revisões de código, depuração full-stack, refatoração de código legado e estruturação de componentes frontend (scaffolding). - Valoriza-se muito a experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA para assistência no planejamento de sprints, documentação técnica e geração automatizada de testes. - Inglês fluente para atuação em times internacionais.Desejável (Diferenciais)- Experiência com plataformas de CRM, sistemas de gestão de concessionárias ou produtos SaaS em mercados verticais. - Histórico em projetos de migração de frontend (ex: views PHP legadas para SPAs em Angular/React). - Familiaridade com funcionalidades de SMS, e-mail e telefonia em um contexto de CRM. - Experiência com otimização de desempenho para aplicações web de alto tráfego. - Exposição a ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (New Relic, Datadog ou similar). - Experiência de trabalho com equipes de engenharia distribuídas ou remote-first em vários fusos horários.

title: Product Builder - Ia & Automação (Vp De Gente)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Product Builder - Ia & Automação (Vp De Gente) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Product Builder - IA & Automação (VP de Gente)Sobre o DesafioBuscamos uma pessoa protagonista para liderar a intersecção entre Inteligência Artificial e o time de Gente. Este profissional não será apenas um executor, mas um explorador: alguém capaz de navegar pelo subsistemas de Gente, identificar gargalos (como a atração, turnover em operações e processos como orçamento de pessoal) e transformá-los em produtos digitais inteligentes. Você será o braço direito da transformação digital no RH, com reporte à VP de Digital e linha funcional (dotted line) para a VP de Gente. Sua missão não é apenas "liderar processos", mas sim idear, prototipar e construir (mão na massa) ferramentas de IA e automações que movam os ponteiros de negócio do Grupo.Seu Papel: "One-Person Squad" Nesta posição, você não terá um time de desenvolvimento dedicado. Você operará sob o modelo de Product as a Business, onde você é o dono do ROI e o executor técnico da solução. Você contará com o suporte das áreas centrais de Tech e Dados para consumo de APIs e infraestrutura, mas a construção do MVP e a evolução do produto são de sua total responsabilidade.Principais Responsabilidades- Discovery e Construção (End-to-End): Mapear oportunidades no ciclo de vida do colaborador (Atração, Turnover, Orçamento) e construir soluções funcionais usando GenAI, Agentes de IA, Python e ferramentas de automação para resolver problemas reais. - Ownership de Resultado (P&L): Definir e garantir o sucesso financeiro das automações. O sucesso é medido pela redução de custos operacionais, otimização de processos de remuneração e impacto direto no EBITDA. - Evangelização Técnica: Elevar a maturidade tecnológica do time de Gente, demonstrando através de entregas reais o poder da IA na produtividade. - Integração Sistêmica: Garantir que suas soluções "conversem" com o ecossistema atual (SAP, Corp, Dados), atuando com autonomia decisória conforme a nova Matriz de Papéis da SBF.Perfil Desejado- Mentalidade Builder: Experiência prévia em criar produtos ou automações de forma independente. Você prefere "codar com IA" para resolver problemas reais e experimentar rápido do que apenas escrever PRDs. - Autonomia Radical e Low Support: Você terá liberdade total, mas também baixo suporte operacional. É fundamental conseguir "andar sozinho", tomar decisões técnicas e resolver impedimentos sem depender de supervisão constante ou de um time de apoio. - Alfabetização Avançada em IA: Entendimento profundo de LLMs, arquitetura de Agentes, Engenharia de Prompt e análise preditiva. - Domínio de Ferramentas de Produtividade Aumentada: Fluência em ferramentas como Antigravity, Cursor/Windsurf, Copilot, Google Suite (Apps Script/APIs), n8n, Python e integração via APIs. - Fundamentos de Produto: Domínio do ciclo completo de um produto, incluindo técnicas de Discovery contínuo, Gestão de Projetos/Roadmap e Análise de Dados para suporte à decisão. - Visão de Negócio: Capacidade de traduzir uma "dor de RH" em uma métrica de valor para a companhia. - Comunicação Estratégica: Habilidade para transitar entre a visão técnica e o discurso executivo para VPs e stakeholders.Diferenciais - Experiência em projetos de People Analytics. - Vivência em ambientes de varejo ou tech de rápido crescimento. - Portfólio de projetos autorais ou automações construídas "pelo prazer de resolver problemas".E aí, topa entrar em campo com a gente e revolucionar o nosso ecossistema com IA?

title: Sre / Devops Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Sre / Devops Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

SRE / DevOps EngineerSobre a FunçãoO Engenheiro de SRE/DevOps será dedicado à confiabilidade e infraestrutura, estabelecendo a base para a excelência de produção em toda a organização de engenharia.Você trabalhará em todas as equipes (CRM, Plataforma, IA, Mobile e Dados), detendo a responsabilidade pela infraestrutura de confiabilidade, observabilidade e implantação de uma plataforma de CRM multi-serviços rodando na AWS, reportando-se ao Gerente de Engenharia e colaborando com cada Tech Lead.O Que Você Fará- Deter e evoluir a infraestrutura de pipelines de CI/CD, permitindo implantações rápidas, seguras e repetíveis em múltiplos serviços e ambientes. - Construir e manter a Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) para todos os recursos da AWS, eliminando a configuração manual e garantindo a reprodutibilidade. - Projetar e implementar sistemas abrangentes de monitoramento, alerta e observabilidade usando IA em combinação com ferramentas como New Relic, CloudWatch e painéis (dashboards) personalizados. - Gerenciar e otimizar a infraestrutura AWS, incluindo EC2, RDS (MySQL 8.0), Lambda, CloudWatch e serviços relacionados. - Estabelecer e acompanhar Objetivos de Nível de Serviço (SLOs) e Indicadores de Nível de Serviço (SLIs) para medir e melhorar a confiabilidade da plataforma. - Liderar processos de resposta a incidentes, incluindo procedimentos de sobreaviso (on-call), runbooks, revisões pós-incidente e rastreamento de remediações. - Otimizar o desempenho do banco de dados em escala, incluindo identificação de consultas lentas (slow queries), otimização de índices, gerenciamento de pool de conexões e saúde da replicação. - Automatizar tarefas operacionais que atualmente são manuais, reduzindo o trabalho repetitivo (toil) e liberando as equipes de engenharia para focar no desenvolvimento de funcionalidades. - Reforçar as práticas de segurança na infraestrutura, incluindo configuração de rede, gerenciamento de segredos, controles de acesso e conformidade com auditorias de segurança. - Colaborar com as equipes de funcionalidades no planejamento de capacidade, testes de desempenho e decisões de arquitetura que impactam a confiabilidade. - Construir ferramentas internas e documentação que permitam aos desenvolvedores o autoatendimento (self-serve) em necessidades comuns de infraestrutura. - Participar de avaliações de segurança e remediação de testes de intrusão (pentests), garantindo que a infraestrutura atenda aos padrões de segurança.O Que Você Traz (Requisitos)- Mais de 5 anos de experiência em funções de SRE, DevOps ou engenharia de infraestrutura. - Forte proficiência com serviços AWS, particularmente EC2, RDS (MySQL), Lambda, CloudWatch, IAM, VPC e S3. - Experiência prática com ferramentas de Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible ou equivalente). - Experiência profunda com sistemas de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Jenkins, GitHub Actions ou similares), incluindo construção e manutenção de pipelines de implantação para arquiteturas de múltiplos serviços. - Fortes habilidades de administração de sistemas Linux e capacidade de escrita de scripts (Bash, Python). - Sólida compreensão da administração de bancos de dados MySQL, incluindo replicação, backup/recuperação, ajuste de desempenho (tuning) e gerenciamento de conexões. - Experiência com plataformas de monitoramento e observabilidade (New Relic, Datadog, Prometheus/Grafana ou similar). - Familiaridade com tecnologias de conteinerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes ou ECS). - Compreensão de fundamentos de rede (DNS, balanceamento de carga, VPN, regras de firewall, SSL/TLS). - Fortes habilidades de gerenciamento de incidentes, incluindo experiência na definição de escalas de sobreaviso, redação de runbooks e condução de post-mortems isentos de culpa (blameless). - Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa com várias equipes de engenharia. - Experiência demonstrada no uso de ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistidas por IA nos fluxos diários de engenharia. Isso inclui ferramentas como Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Amazon CodeWhisperer ou assistentes de codificação de IA semelhantes para tarefas como escrever e revisar Infraestrutura como Código, gerar runbooks, automatizar a triagem de incidentes, analisar logs e estruturar configurações de monitoramento.Desejável (Diferenciais)- Experiência com implantação e otimização de aplicações PHP (nossa plataforma principal é CakePHP). - Experiência anterior em plataformas SaaS ou arquiteturas multi-tenant. - Familiaridade com frameworks de conformidade de segurança (SOC 2, remediação de testes de intrusão). - Experiência com otimização de custos para cargas de trabalho AWS. - Conhecimento de implantação de aplicações Node.Js e Python. - Experiência com agregação e análise de logs (ELK Stack, CloudWatch Logs Insights). - Histórico de migração de infraestrutura manual/legada para ambientes modernos gerenciados por IaC. - Experiência de trabalho com equipes de engenharia distribuídas ou remotas. - Valoriza-se muito a experiência no uso de ferramentas de IA para remediação de auditorias de segurança, análise de otimização de custos e documentação operacional.

title: Senior Procurement Specialist
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Senior Procurement Specialist em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Work Location: São Paulo, BrazilReport To: JD Industrial Brazil Business LeaderBusiness Type: Cross-border Industrial Supply Chain / MRO Industrial Products Procurement & SalesI. Business IntroductionJD Industrial is the core business segment of JD Group focusing on industrial supply chain technology and services. We have established a localized operation system in Brazil, focusing on providing end-to-end MRO industrial product supply chain solutions for Chinese-funded overseas enterprises and local large-scale manufacturing/energy/infrastructure enterprises.- Core Positioning: Serve customers in Brazil's manufacturing, energy, mining, infrastructure and other industries, providing one-stop procurement, cross-border/local fulfillment, inventory management, supply chain finance and other services for full-category MRO (Maintenance, Repair, Operations) industrial products. - Core Advantages: Relying on JD's global supply chain network, local warehousing, distribution and compliance capabilities in Brazil, and digital procurement platform, we solve the pain points of the Brazilian market such as high prices, long delivery times, scattered suppliers and complex certifications. - Business Scope: Covering full MRO categories including tools, labor protection, electrical, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, and spare parts, supporting the dual model of cross-border procurement + local procurement, and realizingfast delivery, compliant customs clearance and credit period settlement in Brazil.II. Key Job Responsibilities1. Development and Management of Local MRO Suppliers in Brazil (Core)- In-depth development of local MRO suppliers in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.), and establishment of a localized supplier resource pool. - Responsible for supplier access, evaluation, negotiation, signing, maintenance and elimination, and building a hierarchical supplier system (head/potential/long-tail). - Familiar with the price system, certification requirements (INMETRO), delivery time, credit period and payment habits (OA 90 days, letter of credit installments) of the Brazilian MRO market.2. MRO Category Procurement and Cost Management- Responsible for the full-category MRO procurement in Brazil, undertaking customer needs, and completing the entire process of inquiry, price comparison, negotiation, order placement, fulfillment, reconciliation and settlement. - Formulate category procurement strategies, price systems and cost targets, optimize procurement costs, and improve price competitiveness, gross profit and inventory turnover. - Analyze the supply and demand, competitors, prices, delivery times and policies of the Brazilian MRO market, and formulate category planning, commodity structure and stock-up strategies.3. Customer Demand Connection and Solution Output- Connect with local Chinese-funded/large-scale enterprise customers in Brazil, explore MRO procurement needs, and provide one-stop procurement solutions, cost optimization, delivery guarantee and inventory management. - Coordinate the entire link of cross-border procurement, local procurement, customs clearance, logistics fulfillment and local delivery to ensure timely, compliant and low-cost delivery. - Maintain customer relationships, improve repurchase rate, satisfaction and penetration rate, and promote large customer signing, project landing and category expansion.4. Supply Chain Operation and Data Management- Responsible for the entire link operation of MRO inventory, orders, delivery, reconciliation and settlement, ensuring healthy inventory, timely delivery, compliant credit period and fund safety. - Track data such as sales, procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time, and output weekly/monthly/analysis reports to support business decisions. - Coordinate with JD Industrial's global procurement, cross-border logistics, digital systems, risk control and compliance teams to ensure coordinated, efficient and compliant business operations.5. Compliance and Risk Management- Familiar with Brazilian compliance requirements such as import tariffs, INMETRO certification, commodity inspection, customs declaration, taxation, foreign exchange and labor laws, ensuring that procurement and delivery are legal and compliant. - Control supplier risks, price risks, delivery risks, inventory risks, fund risks and compliance risks.III. Job Requirements1. Core Competencies (Must-Have)- Local MRO Supplier Resources in Brazil: Must have local MRO industrial product supplier resources in Brazil (tools, electrical, labor protection, hydraulic, transmission, chemical, spare parts, etc.). - MRO Procurement Professional Ability: 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement experience in Brazil/Latin America, familiar with MRO categories, products, prices, certifications, delivery times, credit periods and procurement processes. - In-depth Understanding of the Brazilian Market: Familiar with Brazil's industrial market, customer structure, supplier ecology, price system, certification (INMETRO), tariffs, foreign exchange and payment habits.2. Professional Skills- Business Negotiation: Strong ability in price negotiation, negotiation, contract signing and supplier management. - Cost and Data Analysis: Price-sensitive, strong cost awareness, proficient in analyzing procurement, cost, gross profit, inventory and delivery time data. - Language Ability: Fluent in Portuguese (native/business level), proficient in English;  fluent in Chinese is preferred. - Office Tools: Proficient in Excel, PPT, Word and ERP/procurement systems.3. Comprehensive Quality- Business Thinking: Possess the ability of category operation, cost control, profit orientation and inventory management. - Customer Orientation: Customer-first, strong service awareness, demand exploration, solution output and customer maintenance. - Pressure Resistance and Execution: Result-oriented, strong pressure resistance, strong execution, cross-departmental collaboration and rapid implementation. - Compliance and Integrity: Integrity and self-discipline, strong compliance awareness, risk control and high professional quality.4. Education and Experience- Bachelor's degree or above, major in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, International Trade, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering is preferred. - 3-5 years of MRO industrial product procurement/sales experience in Brazil/Latin America;  experience in local Brazilian supplier resources, Chinese-funded enterprise services and cross-border procurement is preferred.IV. What We Offer- International Platform: JD Industrial's global business, with collaboration between the local Brazilian team and the China headquarters. - Salary and Benefits: Highly competitive salary + performance bonus + annual bonus + local Brazilian social security + commercial insurance + paid annual leave + overseas subsidies. - Development Space: Promotion paths such as MRO Category Manager, Regional Procurement & Sales Director, and JD Industrial Brazil Business Leader. - Localization Support: Local office in Brazil, local team, compliance support, supply chain support and customer resources.

title: Superintendente Arquitetura E Novas Soluções

Criada em 2011, a Zurich Santander Insurance America é uma joint venture entre os grupos Zurich e o Banco Santander, dois dos maiores conglomerados mundiais nos setores de seguros e financeiro. Com uma das maiores carteiras de seguros do mercado, temos sede na Espanha e comercializamos nossos produtos por meio do canal de vendas do Banco Santander no Brasil, México, Chile, Argentina e Uruguai.Na Zurich Santander, trabalhamos todos os dias para que você seja o protagonista de nossa história e tenha o espaço que merece dentro da nossa empresa. Se você é uma pessoa inovadora, dinâmica, proativa, gosta de desafios e trabalha bem em equipe, este é o seu lugar!Nosso objetivo é oferecer a você as melhores experiências, queremos que se junte a nós para que juntos possamos construir o futuro da Zurich Santander!Qual será o seu desafio?Buscamos uma liderança visionária para capitanear nossa estratégia de arquitetura de sistemas e a prospecção de novas tecnologias. Será o guardião da integridade técnica da empresa, liderando arquitetos e engenheiros na construção de ecossistemas robustos, além de atuar como um catalisador de inovação, transformando tendências tecnológicas em vantagens competitivas reais.Quais serão suas principais responsabilidades?- Visão Estratégica: Definir o roadmap tecnológico de longo prazo (Target Architecture), garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos de negócio.- Liderança Técnica: Coordenar e mentorar o time de arquitetos (Sistemas, Dados e Cloud), promovendo as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e design.- Novas Soluções: Liderar a área de R&D (Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento), avaliando tecnologias emergentes (IA, Web3, Edge Computing, etc.) e conduzindo Provas de Conceito (PoCs).- Governança e Padrões: Estabelecer padrões arquiteturais, princípios de design e critérios de segurança para garantir a qualidade e a escalabilidade das entregas.- Gestão de Stakeholders: Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e o C-Level, traduzindo conceitos técnicos complexos em valor de negócio.- Otimização de Custos: Gerir a eficiência da infraestrutura (Cloud FinOps) e o licenciamento de soluções de terceiros.- Tomada de Decisão (Buy vs. Build): Analisar criticamente se as soluções devem ser desenvolvidas internamente ou adquiridas no mercado.Quais são os requisitos que procuramos?- Experiência Sênior: Sólida trajetória em arquitetura de software, infraestrutura em nuvem e liderança de times técnicos de alta performance.- Arquitetura Moderna: Domínio profundo de Microserviços, Event-Driven Architecture (EDA), APIs (REST/GraphQL), Serverless e Cloud Native.- Ambiente Cloud: Experiência avançada em AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud.- Ecossistema de Dados: Conhecimento em arquiteturas de Big Data, Data Lakes e integração de modelos de Machine Learning.- Segurança: Experiência na implementação de conceitos de Security by Design e conformidade (LGPD).- Metodologias: Fluência em Agilidade (Scrum/Kanban) e práticas modernas de DevOps/SRE.Para que possa fazer a diferença, é ideal que você tenha as seguintes softskills para esta função:- Pensamento Sistêmico: Capacidade de enxergar o todo e antecipar o impacto de mudanças em grande escala.- Influência e Negociação: Habilidade para convencer stakeholders e alinhar expectativas entre áreas distintas e banco.- Curiosidade Intelectual: Mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo para se manter à frente das tendências globais.- Resiliência: Capacidade de liderar em ambientes de rápida mudança e alta complexidade. Diferenciais:- Experiência em processos de Transformação Digital ou migrações de sistemas legados de larga escala.- Certificações de nível Professional/Specialty em provedores de Cloud.- Participação ativa em comunidades de tecnologia ou contribuição para projetos Open Source.Qual é a nossa Proposta de Valor?Na Zurich Santander lhe propomos fazer parte de uma organização comprometida com o contexto atual, trabalhando profissionalmente na transformação da indústria bancária/seguradora, oferecendo-lhe crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.Contamos com um excelente ambiente de trabalho, uma equipa de profissionais diversificada e internacional, incentivamos a mobilidade dentro dos países onde estamos presentes para que possa continuar a crescer como profissional. Além disso, dispomos de um pacote de remuneração e benefícios competitivo e atrativo para os nossos colaboradores.Junte-se à nossa equipe!#JuntosprotegemosoquemaisimportaO CANDIDATO reconhece que, ao enviar o Curriculum Vitae e/ou preencher a candidatura a uma vaga de emprego, fornecendo as informações ali contidas, aceita que os dados pessoais sejam utilizados pelo ZURICH SANTANDER para a avaliação decorrente do processo seletivo. Como essa é a única finalidade de análise para avaliação do candidato, essas informações poderão ser compartilhadas com empresas que nos apoiam na avaliação do processo seletivo. Os dados do CANDIDATO serão guardados com o máximo de cuidado e atenção, e serão mantidos pelo período de tempo previsto em lei.

title: Tech Lead - Platform Engineering
description:
