Você se reportará diretamente ao Engineering Manager e trabalhará em estreita colaboração com Produto, QA e outras equipes de engenharia para garantir a confiabilidade, escalabilidade e segurança da plataforma.Principais responsabilidades- Detenção da visão técnica e arquitetura da camada de plataforma e integrações, incluindo design de APIs REST, integrações de provedores terceiros (SMS, e-mail, telefonia) e confiabilidade de pipelines de dados. - Liderar e mentorar uma equipe de engenheiros de back-end, realizando revisões de código (code reviews), sessões de pairing e fornecendo orientação para o crescimento na carreira. - Impulsionar a tomada de decisões técnicas para dilemas de build vs. buy, compensações (trade-offs) de arquitetura e adoção de tecnologias. - Parceria com o time de Produto para traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas bem dimensionadas, garantindo que o trabalho de engenharia esteja alinhado ao roadmap do produto. - Estabelecer e aplicar padrões de engenharia para qualidade de código, testes, documentação e processos de release. - Gerir a dívida técnica de forma estratégica, equilibrando a velocidade de entrega de funcionalidades (velocity) com a saúde do sistema. - Colaborar com a função de SRE/DevOps em pipelines de implantação, monitoramento e resposta a incidentes para serviços de plataforma. - Participar do planejamento de sprints, estimativas e gestão de capacidade da equipe. - Coordenar com outros Tech Leads as dependências entre times, serviços compartilhados e decisões arquiteturais. - Contribuir para os esforços de contratação, incluindo a definição de requisitos da função, triagem de candidatos e condução de entrevistas técnicas.Requisitos:- Pelo menos 7 anos de experiência profissional em engenharia de software, com pelo menos 3 anos em cargos de liderança técnica (Tech Lead, Staff Engineer ou equivalente). - Forte proficiência em PHP (CakePHP ou frameworks MVC semelhantes) e MySQL, com experiência em operação em escala de produção. - Experiência profunda em projetar, construir e manter APIs RESTful e integrar serviços de terceiros (ex: Twilio, SendGrid, Nylas ou similares). - Sólida compreensão de design de bancos de dados relacionais, otimização de consultas e integridade de dados em escala. - Experiência com serviços de nuvem AWS (EC2, RDS, Lambda, CloudWatch) ou plataformas de nuvem equivalentes. - Capacidade comprovada de liderar e desenvolver uma equipe de 5 ou mais engenheiros, incluindo mentoria, feedback de desempenho e desenvolvimento de carreira. - Fortes habilidades de comunicação, com capacidade de articular conceitos técnicos para stakeholders não técnicos. - Familiaridade com metodologias Agile/Scrum e ferramentas (Jira, Confluence ou similares). - Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD, controle de versão (Git/Bitbucket) e fluxos de trabalho de desenvolvimento modernos. - Experiência demonstrada no uso de ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistidas por IA nos fluxos diários de engenharia. Isso inclui ferramentas como Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Amazon CodeWhisperer ou assistentes de codificação de IA semelhantes para tarefas como geração de código, revisões, investigação de bugs, validação de contratos de API e depuração de integração. - Valoriza-se muito a experiência em alavancar ferramentas de IA para geração de documentação, estruturação de testes (test scaffolding) e pesquisas técnicas (spikes). - Inglês fluente para atuar em times internacionais.Diferenciais:- Experiência com Node.Js ou Python como linguagem secundária de back-end. - Experiência anterior em CRM, gestão de concessionárias (dealer management) ou plataformas SaaS para mercados verticais. - Experiência com sistemas de telefonia (Twilio, SIP/VoIP), infraestrutura de entrega de e-mail (SendGrid, SES) ou integrações de DMS. - Familiaridade com as melhores práticas de segurança para autenticação de API (JWT, OAuth) e proteção de dados. - Experiência na migração de sistemas legados ou na liderança de grandes esforços de refatoração (refactoring). - Exposição a ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (New Relic, Datadog ou similar).

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior Software Engineer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About PiecePiece is a holding company that acquires vertical software/AI businesses and scales them through creator-powered distribution. We believe the next Latin American giants will emerge at the intersection of AI and creator economy — software brings technology, recurring revenue, and LTV;  creators bring audience, trust, and distribution. Piece brings them together.Our edge is a proprietary creator-focused distribution engine that uses AI to automate growth across our vertical software portfolio — social media, sales funnels, content, and creator operations. Every vertical we add makes the machine smarter, compounding proprietary data on what works in creator-led distribution for AI/Software. Our goal is to hit US$10M ARR in 2026.We're building Piece to be a home for some of the most exceptional people in the world. Talent density is non-negotiable, the bar is unreasonably high, and we expect excellence in everything we ship. Our ambition is to put Brazil on the map as a global protagonist in growth and distribution.The RoleWe're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to be the technical pillar of the product at the first and main company in our portfolio — someone who combines technical depth with product sense, and who will own the architecture, evolution, and operation of its entire backend and AI infrastructure.You'll be hands-on building and scaling the systems that orchestrate our agents, process messages in real time, and sustain the platform's accelerated growth. This isn't a maintenance role — it's a building role.If you enjoy solving complex problems in distributed systems, have a genuine interest in applied AI, and want to build something that's reshaping how the Brazilian legal market operates, this is the place. You'll join as part of our founding team, with competitive compensation and meaningful equity through stock options.What you'll doBackend architecture and evolution- Design and evolve the microservices that power the platform, with a focus on scalability and maintainability - Make technical decisions autonomously — database modeling, API design, stack choices - Raise the team's technical bar through code review and mentorshipAI agents and LLMs- Build and evolve our agent pipelines: orchestration, tool calling, dynamic workflows, and intelligent routing - Optimize cost and latency of LLM calls without compromising quality - Evolve our RAG, document processing, and voice synthesis featuresIntegrations and operations- Ensure reliability of asynchronous message flows and external integrations - Build new integrations as the product evolves - Maintain operational stability in a multi-tenant system with paying customersQuality and observability- Ensure end-to-end traceability across synchronous and asynchronous flows - Structure operational metrics and maintain visibility over agent behavior in production - Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks before they become incidentsWhat we expect from youBackend & Systems- Proficiency with Node.Js + TypeScript in high-throughput production systems — including API design, modular architecture, and long-term maintainability decisions - Strong grasp of event-driven and asynchronous architectures: message queues, pub/sub patterns, idempotency, retry logic, and failure isolation in distributed systems - Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS backends: data isolation strategies, per-tenant configuration, and operational complexity at scale - Solid database modeling — relational (schema design, indexing, query optimization) and NoSQL (document modeling, consistency trade-offs) — and ability to choose the right store for the problem - Hands-on cloud experience (GCP preferred): Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore/Cloud SQL, IAM, and observability toolingAI & Agent Systems- Experience building LLM-powered pipelines in production — not just calling APIs, but thinking through orchestration, context management, fallback behavior, and output reliability - Understanding of agent architectures: tool calling, multi-step reasoning, routing logic, state management across turns, and how to make agents predictable in real-world conditions - Practical knowledge of RAG pipelines: chunking strategies, embedding selection, retrieval quality, and reranking — and awareness of where RAG breaks down - Cost and latency awareness in LLM usage: prompt engineering for efficiency, model selection trade-offs, caching strategies, and when not to use an LLM - Familiarity with evaluation and observability for AI systems: how to measure agent quality, detect regressions, and maintain visibility over non-deterministic behavior in productionProduct & Technical Judgment- Ability to reason about product trade-offs, not just technical ones — understands what to build, what to cut, and why - Comfortable operating with ambiguity: capable of going from a fuzzy problem to a concrete technical proposal without needing a fully-specced ticket - Has opinions about prioritization and isn't just an executor — questions requirements upstream and thinks about user and business impact before writing the first line of code - Uses AI tools natively in the development workflow (coding assistants, automated testing, code review, documentation) and stays current with the evolving tooling landscape. Understands that development velocity is a competitive advantage, not just an output metricQuality & Operational Maturity- Ability to instrument distributed systems end-to-end: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, and SLO thinking - Experience operating asynchronous flows with real customers: understanding of what breaks silently and how to catch it before they do - Comfort with ambiguity — able to define the right technical approach when the problem itself is still being figured outNice to have- Python for ML/data pipelines or LLM experimentation - Go for latency-critical or high-throughput services - Experience with LLM fine-tuning, RLHF, or systematic model evaluation - Background in regulated or compliance-heavy domains (legaltech, fintech)What we offer- Founding team seat — real ownership of what gets built and how - Competitive compensation - Meaningful stock options - On-site environment with high talent density and direct exposure to foundersDetails- Work model: On-site (São Paulo or São José dos Campos) - Availability: Full-time - Contract: PJ

Diversity: We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger. The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses. This role is a fit for a Sr. Designer ready to step up, an Associate Design Director from a smaller shop looking to grow within a larger team, or a Lead Web Designer seeking to advance their career within a high-growth agency. You'll work closely with project managers, UX strategists, and developers throughout the full project lifecycle — from early strategy through final execution — while managing multiple projects at a time. This role is client-facing: you'll design systems, shape web content strategies, present work, lead design conversations, and collaborate across the team to deliver cohesive, high-quality web experiences. We're looking for someone proactive and self-sufficient, with a strong UX foundation and the experience to hit the ground running in a fast-paced agency environment. You'll also provide leadership to mid-level and junior designers, working with a Design Director to help shape creative vision while setting standards for quality, process, and visual storytelling.What You'll Do ● Own the creative process. Design end-to-end web experiences for enterprise clients — translating UX strategy into polished visual execution, from wireframes through final design, ensuring each web project delivers clarity, impact, and BX-level quality. ● Develop visual identity systems from scratch in short timeframes, adapting them into cohesive, scalable websites. ● Lead web content strategy—structuring information, messaging, and design patterns to maximize storytelling and usability. ● Design websites in Webflow-first workflows, collaborating closely with developers for seamless execution. ● Collaborate actively with PMs, UX strategists, and developers across every phase of the project. ● Present and communicate design decisions to clients with clarity and confidence. ● Balance multiple active projects simultaneously, managing your time efficiently across each. ● Contribute to a collaborative team culture — sharing feedback, flagging blockers early, and keeping work moving. ● Mentor and guide mid-level and junior designers, elevating their work and modeling best practices. ● Collaborate with cross-functional teams (graphics, UX, dev) to bring ambitious websites to life. ● Implement and refine processes within the design team to ensure smooth collaboration, efficient iteration, and consistent high quality. ● Stay ahead of trends in web design, storytelling, and Webflow workflows—bringing new ideas into BX Studio projects.What We're Looking For ● 4+ years of web design experience, ideally within an agency setting. Ideally, with B2B companies, SaaS brands, and digital-first identities. ● Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end web projects with clear UX and visual thinking, including strategy, visual identity, UX/UI, and final design execution. ● Strong UX foundation: wireframing, information architecture, and user flow thinking alongside visual craft. ● Comfortable working across a full project team — PMs, strategists, and developers — in a structured, waterfall workflow. ● Proven ability to lead client conversations, present creative directions, and navigate feedback professionally with clarity and confidence. ● Experience developing visual identity systems and scalable design systems applied across digital experiences. ● Solid foundation in content strategy, information architecture, and UX principles. ● High proficiency in Figma required.;  Webflow and Adobe Creative Suite a plus. ● Strong leadership potential—experience mentoring or leading designers highly preferred. ● Proactive and organized — capable of managing multiple projects and taking initiative without waiting to be directed. ● Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment.Why Join BX Studio? ● Lead ambitious web projects for innovative B2B and SaaS brands. ● Step into a role that bridges Sr. Designer and Associate Design Director responsibilities. ● Grow your leadership skills while still working hands-on with design. ● Collaborate with a talented, supportive, and high-standard team in a flexible remote environment.

title: Network Operations Center Technician
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Network Operations Center Technician em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM  Location : Campinas, Brazil  Role Overview   We are expanding our Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation  and are looking for a SOC / NOC Technician (L1)  to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our platform and connectivity environments . This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability . Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2.  Key Responsibilities   Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior . Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents. Classify incidents by domain: platform, connectivity, or device-related . Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues. Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration. Create, update, and manage incident tickets in Fresh service or similar tools . Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates. Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information. Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams. Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions.   Required Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology , or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. 1–3 years of experience  in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations. Foundational understanding of mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts . Basic knowledge of APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis . Exposure to cloud environments;  AWS basics preferred . Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior. Comfortable working rotational shifts and on-call rotations . Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required . Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination.   Preferred Qualifications   Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers. Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience. Experience with ticketing tools such as Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management . Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900 , or similar are preferred but not mandatory.   Soft Skills   Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable. Calm under pressure. Strong ownership and accountability. Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability. Global mindset and collaborative approach. Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability.   About Acceleronix   Acceleronix is a global IoT solutions and services enablement provider, part of the Quectel ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating IoT projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end IoT platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (eSIM, iSIM, vSIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market. With pan-regional R&D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0.  Life at Acceleronix LATAM   At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect. Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global IoT leader and the Quectel ecosystem Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas Regular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teams A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development   Industries & Applications   Acceleronix's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in: Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security   Why Acceleronix LATAM?   Global Impact, Regional Focus —  Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development —  Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology —  Work on next-generation IoT platforms, cellular connectivity, eSIM/iSIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications. Diversity & Inclusion —  Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success. Global Team & Collaboration —  Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem.   Compensation & Benefits   Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks Performance bonus/sales commission structure (role dependent) Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance) Health insurance with no co-pay Life insurance Paid time off International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows)   Explore Acceleronix — Links & Resources   We encourage all candidates to learn more about Acceleronix before applying. SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM  Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM    Location   : Campinas, Brazil    Role Overview     We are expanding our  Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation   and are looking for a  SOC / NOC Technician (L1)  to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our  platform and connectivity environments  .   This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on  platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability  . Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2.    Key Responsibilities     Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including  APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior  .   Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents.   Classify incidents by domain:  platform, connectivity, or device-related  .   Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues.   Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration.   Create, update, and manage incident tickets in  Fresh service or similar tools  .   Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates.   Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information.   Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams.   Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions.     Required Qualifications     Bachelor’s degree in  Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology  , or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.  1–3 years of experience   in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations.   Foundational understanding of  mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts  .   Basic knowledge of  APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis  .   Exposure to cloud environments;   AWS basics preferred  .   Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior.   Comfortable working  rotational shifts and on-call rotations  .   Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required  .   Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination.     Preferred Qualifications     Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers.   Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience.   Experience with ticketing tools such as  Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management  .   Certifications such as  CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900 , or similar are preferred but not mandatory.     Soft Skills     Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable.   Calm under pressure.   Strong ownership and accountability.   Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability.   Global mindset and collaborative approach.   Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability.     About Acceleronix     Acceleronix is a global IoT solutions and services enablement provider, part of the Quectel ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating IoT projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end IoT platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (eSIM, iSIM, vSIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market.   With pan-regional R&D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0.    Life at Acceleronix LATAM     At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.   Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global IoT leader and the Quectel ecosystem   Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas   Regular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teams   A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development     Industries & Applications     Acceleronix's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:   Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions   Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility   Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking   Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring   Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring   Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility   Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security     Why Acceleronix LATAM?    Global Impact, Regional Focus —   Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.   Career Growth & Development —   Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization.   Cutting-Edge Technology —   Work on next-generation IoT platforms, cellular connectivity, eSIM/iSIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications.   Diversity & Inclusion —   Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success.   Global Team & Collaboration —   Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem.     Compensation & Benefits     Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks   Performance bonus/sales commission structure (role dependent)  Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance)  Health insurance with no co-pay   Life insurance   Paid time off   International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows)    Explore Acceleronix — Links & Resources     We encourage all candidates to learn more about Acceleronix before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here. title: Desenvolvedor fullstack sr (ambiente vtex)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Desenvolvedor fullstack sr (ambiente vtex) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sobre nós - Grupo ReviseO Grupo Revise, atua há mais de 29 anos no setor automotivo brasileiro, destaca-se pela qualidade certificada e pelo pioneirismo. Como uma empresa 100% brasileira, possui 3 marcas, sendo: (Brazzo, Mobato e Varimax), com 8 centros de distribuição estratégicos em todo o país e um amplo portfólio que inclui milhares de itens de alta qualidade em prol da satisfação dos clientes, reforçados pela certificação ISO 9001:2015.Principais Responsabilidades   Desenvolver e manter componentes de vitrine, checkout, landing page e demais funcionalidades da plataforma *VTEX IO*.     Garantir a integridade do fluxo de dados entre o *ERP Sankhya* e o e-commerce através do middleware em *Java*.     Monitorar logs de erro de integração para evitar rupturas de estoque ou divergências de preço.     Otimizar a performance do banco de dados (*SQL Server/MySQL*) para suportar picos de tráfego (ex: Black Friday).     Realizar novas integrações que envolva e eCommerce (Bot, Meio de Pagamentos, etc).     Pioneirismo digital: Apoiar a consolidação do e-commerce como pilar estratégico de faturamento.     Integração VTEX  Sankhya: Garantir comunicação eficiente e consistente entre plataforma e ERP, com alto volume de dados em tempo real.     Middleware em Java: Evoluir e otimizar a solução existente, assegurando escalabilidade da operação.     Geração de valor: Traduzir necessidades do negócio em soluções digitais de alta conversão via VTEX IO.     Autonomia e resolução de problemas: Atuar de forma proativa na melhoria contínua e decisões técnicas.     Performance e estabilidade: Manter bancos SQL Server e MySQL otimizados, garantindo boa experiência do usuário.     O Que Esperamos De Você Front-End (Ambiente VTEX)   VTEX IO: Experiência obrigatória com o framework VTEX IO (desenvolvimento de apps, Store Framework e customização de blocos).     React.js  TypeScript: Domínio avançado para criação de componentes performáticos e tipagem segura.     CSS-in-JS / Tachyons: Conhecimento no sistema de estilização nativo da VTEX e bibliotecas modernas.     Consumo de APIs: Experiência com GraphQL e REST para busca de dados e manipulação de prateleiras/checkout.      Back-End  Integração (Java)   Java (Core): Sólidos conhecimentos em Java (8 ou superior) para manutenção e evolução do middleware existente.     Spring Boot: Desejável conhecimento no ecossistema Spring para gestão da camada de integração.     Arquitetura de APIs: Criação e consumo de Web Services (REST/SOAP) para comunicação entre VTEX e o ERP Sankhya (preferencialmente Sankhya, não obrigatório).     Mensageria: Conhecimento em filas (ex: RabbitMQ ou SQS) para garantir que as transações de pedidos não se percam.      Banco de Dados   SQL Server  MySQL: Capacidade de realizar queries complexas, otimização de procedures e modelagem de dados para espelhamento de estoque e preços.      Ecossistema ERP Sankhya   Sankhya (Integrações): Conhecimento em tabelas nativas do Sankhya (ou outros ERP) e chamadas de API via Java.     Regras de Negócio: Entendimento de fluxo de pedidos, faturamento e sincronização de SKUs.      SecDevOps  Qualidade de Código   Security-First Mindset: Implementação de práticas de segurança desde a escrita do código (SAST/DAST) para proteção de dados sensíveis no tráfego entre VTEX, Middleware e Sankhya.     Criptografia e Proteção de Dados: Conhecimento em protocolos de segurança para APIs e tratamento de dados em conformidade com a LGPD (crucial para o fluxo no SQL Server/MySQL).     CI/CD Seguro: Configuração de esteiras de deploy que incluam verificações automáticas de vulnerabilidades em bibliotecas Java e dependências NPM.      Desenvolvimento Potencializado por IA   Domínio de IA Generativa (Claude Code): Uso obrigatório do Claude Code (ou ferramentas Anthropic) como copiloto estratégico para aceleração de escrita de código, refatoração de sistemas Legados em Java e geração de testes unitários.     Prompt Engineering Técnico: Capacidade de utilizar IA para diagnosticar gargalos de performance e documentar processos de integração complexos entre o ERP e o E-commerce.        Você se destaca se tiver:  Certificação oficial VTEX.  Experiência com Master Data v2.  Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento (New Relic ou Datadog).  Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

description:

OBRIGATÓRIOS:Formação: Nível superior completo em uma das áreas seguintes: Análise de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Processamento de Dados, Sistemas de Informação, Informática, Engenharia da Computação, Segurança da Informação ou curso superior completo em qualquer área e especialização, com no mínimo 360 horas, na área de Segurança da Informação;  Inglês técnico: Importante para leitura de documentos técnicos.  DESEJÁVEIS: Experiência na análise de logs de eventos de diversos ativos (logs de sistema operacional, firewall ou outros); Ter vivência em tratamento de incidentes de segurança; Ter conhecimento sobre SIEM (O que é, para que serve, principais players); Capacidade de escalonar incidentes de segurança para o segundo nível; Conhecimento dos estágios de um ataque (Reconnaissance/Enumeration, Weaponize/Gaining access, Privilege Escalation, Persistence, Lateral Movement, Exfiltration); Ter conhecimento dos modelos Cyber Kill Chain e MITRE ATT&CK Lifecycle; Conhecimentos em sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux; Conhecimentos em redes de computadores; IBM QRadar/Microsoft Sentinel; Tenable Manager Engine Patch Manager/DLP/ADaudit Trend Micro XDR/EDR Axur   Monitoramento e Investigação  Monitoramento de Alertas: Atuar na equipe de SOC monitorando alertas de segurança de complexidades diversas (baixa a crítica) em tempo real. Análise de Logs: Investigar eventos através do SIEM, correlacionando dados de firewalls, rede e endpoints. Apoio em Threat Hunting: Auxiliar em atividades de caça a ameaças e na análise de relatórios para identificação de TTPs.  Resposta e Gestão de Incidentes  Execução de Resposta: Analisar, conter e remediar incidentes cibernéticos seguindo os framework NIST. Gestão de Chamados: Atender e solucionar chamados de segurança dentro dos prazos estipulados de SLA. Documentação Técnica: Registrar todas as atividades em plataformas de gestão e manter os playbooks e procedimentos operacionais (POPs) atualizados. Priorização: Avaliar o impacto de vulnerabilidades encontradas e auxiliar na organização das correções prioritárias.  Administração de Ferramentas e Suporte  Manutenção de Soluções: Auxiliar na configuração e suporte técnico de ferramentas de segurança (EDR, SIEM, Firewall, IDS/IPS, etc.). Verificações de Rotina: Realizar testes de funcionamento e suporte básico nas soluções de segurança implementadas. Comunicação e Melhoria Contínua Relatórios e Notificações: Criar relatórios de atividades sob demanda e interagir com outras áreas para orientar sobre incidentes. Evolução de Processos: Contribuir com sugestões para o melhoramento contínuo do monitoramento e das boas práticas de segurança da empresa.
